summary: Iteration 46: Guest Cart Flow Testing - All features verified and working. Cart icon visible for ALL users (guest + logged in), guest users can browse, add to cart, view cart page, update quantities, and checkout triggers auth modal (not redirect). Cart persists after login.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx fix confirmed: Cart button no longer wrapped in {user && (...)} - now visible for all users
Mobile menu has 'My Cart' link for guest users (data-testid='mobile-nav-cart-guest')
Cart badge correctly shows item count for guest users
AddToCartPopup has 'Continue Shopping' and 'Go to Cart' buttons working correctly
CartPage shows trust badges (COD Available, Fast Delivery, Easy Returns) and WhatsApp help link
CheckoutAuthModal opens at checkout for guests (NOT redirect to /auth page)
Auth modal has WhatsApp OTP and Email login tabs
Guest cart uses localStorage (pigma_guest_cart key) and syncs to server on login
Empty cart shows 'Your cart is empty' message with Continue Shopping button
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest cart flow fully functional. Key fix was in Header.jsx where cart button was previously wrapped in {user && (...)} making it invisible to guests - this has been fixed. All cart features work for guests: browse products, add to cart (popup appears), view cart page (/cart-page), update quantities, remove items. Checkout triggers CheckoutAuthModal (not redirect). After login, cart persists and user goes to /checkout.
